title: Cabinet Hardware Cabinet Pull 3-Inch Solid Brass Traditional Style | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom cabinetry with cabinet hardware crafted from solid brass, designed to bring a distinctive finishing touch to doors and drawers.

  • Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
  • Transitional look that blends contemporary design with traditional elements
  • Cabinet-mount installation with all mounting hardware included
  • Coordinates easily within a cabinet hardware collection and other versatile bath accessories
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs

  • Type: Cabinet pull
  • Material: Brass
  • Style: Traditional
  • Mounting type: Cabinet mount
  • Dimensions: 3.9-inch L x 1.6-inch H x 0.9-inch W
  • Projection: 1-inch
  • Weight: 0.8 lb
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Cabinet pull and all installation hardware

_previous.title: 3 Inch Cabinet Pull
_previous.description: The Allied Brass collection of decorative cabinet knobs and pulls will compliment your style, from modern and sleek to traditional and elegant. This wide variety of solid brass knobs and pulls will enhance any kitchen or bathroom furnishings.  Small changes go a long way to spruce up any room.  Coordinate these knobs and pulls with other Allied products to compliment your home.
